=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-272 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard lacks redirect-target detection, so numeric file-descriptor redirects can be mistaken for push refspecs and the guard checks the wrong branch.
  WHY: For `git push origin 2>/dev/null`, the guard may check branch `2` instead of the actual push destination and allow an unchecked push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:432-451 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` drops the first positional argument as the remote even when `--repo` has already supplied the remote, causing it to miss the intended refspec.
  WHY: `git push --repo origin HEAD:feature/x` can make the guard check the current branch instead of `feature/x`; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this MAJOR, while other reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The assignment parser does not recognize `+=` assignments, so `GIT_DIR+=...` or `GIT_WORK_TREE+=...` may not be tracked as environment overrides.
  WHY: The guard can operate on the wrong Git directory or mark the command uncertain; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this MAJOR, while openai_gpt-6-luna rated it BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:619-625 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `git_subcommands` assignment parser does not recognize `NAME+=...`, so an assignment-prefixed `git push` may not be recognized as a guarded Git command.
  WHY: The guard can return without checking the push destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1280-1290 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When the push source cannot be resolved, the root guard warns and checks the session checkout instead of requesting confirmation.
  WHY: The checkout may be unrelated to the actual push destination, allowing an unchecked push; severity disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this MAJOR, while other reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-270 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The template's `segment[-1].isdigit()` redirect handling can drop a separated numeric push refspec such as `2` in `git push origin 2 > /dev/null`.
  WHY: The guard checks the current branch rather than branch `2`, so a push to a blocked branch may proceed unchecked.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1019 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root and template merge-status guard copies differ, violating the byte-identity assertion in `test_template_copies_are_identical`.
  WHY: CI reports five failures in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, including the failing copy-parity test.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Ported #6177 (f2bac1d): three tests broken on main by #6124, #6126 and the review_autofix step split. Test and docs only."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py and .claude/commands/audit-plans.md / workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py is unchanged and its parity test requires the command copies to match; neither command copy is changed, and the root copy retains wording that differs from the template.
- requirement: PR description and changelog.d/6055-heal-evidence-bundle.md:21 state that the consumer merge guard distinguishes numeric file-descriptor prefixes from separated or quoted numeric push refspecs and asks for confirmation on unresolved push destinations or sources.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (_shell_segments_with_operators, _push_targets, _evaluate_bash)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The root guard lacks redirect-target detection, `+=` assignment handling, `remote_provided` tracking, and unresolved-source confirmation; the template mishandles separated numeric refspecs; the copies are not byte-identical and the cited behavior tests were removed or fail.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-272 (_shell_segments_with_operators) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root guard lacks redirect-target detection, so `2>/dev/null` can be treated as a push refspec.
  WHY: `git push origin 2>/dev/null` may make the guard check the current branch instead of branch `2`, allowing an unchecked push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:451 (_push_targets) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `refspecs = positionals[1:]` unconditionally drops the first positional even when `--repo` supplied the remote separately.
  WHY: `git push --repo=origin mybranch` pushes `mybranch` but the guard falls back to checking HEAD.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339 (_guarded_git_invocations) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The assignment regex does not match `+=` assignments, so `GIT_DIR+=...` or `GIT_WORK_TREE+=...` is not consumed as an environment override.
  WHY: The guard may operate on the wrong Git directory or mark the command uncertain.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1288-1290 (_evaluate_bash) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `git rev-parse` cannot resolve a push source tip, the guard falls back to checking the session checkout rather than requesting confirmation.
  WHY: The checkout branch may not be the actual push destination, so the push can proceed without verifying its destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, 5 failed, 172 passed | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root and template guard copies are not byte-identical, failing `test_template_copies_are_identical`.
  WHY: The CI test asserts byte identity between the copies.

  Evidence of absence: The PR changed-files list contains no changes to tests/test_audit_plans_command.py or either workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md or .claude/commands/audit-plans.md. The existing test at tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:31-34 requires the command copies to match.

  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (_shell_segments_with_operators, _push_targets, _evaluate_bash) — must remain byte-identical to the template per test_template_copies_are_identical.
